title: Council judge output (one judge, one agent task)
description: AGENTS.md section 5a. Each of the three judges returns this for every finished agent task. `overall` is the judge's score Q_j in [0, 1]; code aggregates the three into Q. Judges do not emit signals: they never influence the plan, only the reward.

failure_pattern.description: Short, reusable label for the main defect (e.g. 'ignored missing_details', 'wrong pykan API'), or null. Two matching labels count as 'the same failure pattern twice' for the refine trigger.
